# 一、KOL合作主流程识别表

> 注：本表为“一、KOL合作主流程识别表”。原表第 3 行 C 列表头为空，根据列内容（邮件主题行）补为“邮件主题”。

| 模板类型 | 阶段 | 邮件主题 | 商务信息关键词 | 联系方式关键词 | 履约信息关键词 | 其他关键字段 | 使用场景说明 | 优先级 | 交付状态 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 首次建联邮件 | 初步接触 | Collaboration Opportunity with LiTime / Product Collaboration Invitation | collaboration; partnership; sponsorship; product review; gifted collaboration; paid collaboration; sample; work together | email; contact; reach out; manager; agency; representative | platform; YouTube; Instagram; TikTok; content format | creator name; channel URL; niche; audience; product category | 品牌第一次主动联系红人，尚未获得明确回复 | 高 | 已整理 | 第一封邮件只筛选兴趣，不代表红人已同意合作 |
| 红人兴趣回复 | 已回复-有兴趣 | Re: Collaboration Opportunity / Interested in Working with LiTime | interested; sounds interesting; would love to; open to; happy to collaborate; tell me more; send details; keen to learn more | best email; WhatsApp; manager; agent; contact person | preferred format; availability; upcoming content; possible timeline | positive reply; request for more information; questions about product | 红人明确表达兴趣，但报价、交付和产品尚未确认 | 高 | 已整理 | 仅回复Thank you或收到邮件，不应识别为有兴趣 |
| 媒体包与数据收集 | 合作评估 | Media Kit and Audience Information Request | media kit; rate card; channel statistics; average views; audience demographics; engagement rate; previous partnerships | manager email; agency contact; booking contact | YouTube analytics; Instagram insights; audience countries; age; gender | monthly views; top countries; US audience; average views; case studies | 红人有兴趣，品牌方开始收集数据并评估是否合作 | 高 | 已整理 | 此阶段还未进入正式报价谈判 |
| 报价收集邮件 | 报价待确认 | Could You Share Your Collaboration Rates? | rate; rate card; pricing; quote; fee; cost; budget; compensation; sponsored rate; integration rate; dedicated video rate | agency; manager; billing contact | deliverables; dedicated video; integration; Short; Reel; Story; usage rights | currency; tax; package; exclusivity; revision fee | 红人提供报价，或品牌方询问不同合作形式的价格 | 高 | 已整理 | 要区分“询问报价”和“报价已确认” |
| 报价谈判邮件 | 商务谈判 | Re: Collaboration Rate and Deliverables | counteroffer; revised rate; budget; flexible; best rate; discounted rate; package rate; final offer; negotiate; within budget | decision maker; manager; agency | video quantity; content length; posting platform; revision; content usage; timeline | original quote; counteroffer; CPM; expected views; sample value | 双方围绕费用、内容数量、授权和发布时间进行谈判 | 高 | 已整理 | 出现报价不代表合作已确认 |
| 合作方案确认邮件 | 方案待确认 | LiTime Collaboration Details — Please Confirm | agreed rate; final rate; compensation; product support; commission; audience code; confirmed budget | contract contact; payment contact; shipping contact | final deliverables; publishing date; product model; usage rights; revision rounds | please confirm; agreed terms; final terms; move forward; proceed | 报价基本谈妥，品牌方发送最终合作条款等待红人确认 | 高 | 已整理 | 出现“please confirm”时仍是待确认；出现“confirmed/agreed”才进入下一阶段 |
| 合同沟通邮件 | 合同签署 | LiTime x {{Creator Name}} Collaboration Agreement | agreement; contract; total fee; payment terms; invoice; tax; currency | signatory; legal name; billing email; payment recipient | deliverables; deadline; usage rights; exclusivity; termination; revision rounds | sign; signed; signature; DocuSign; PDF agreement; NDA | 双方确认合作后进入合同审核和签署 | 高 | 已整理 | 合同已发送与合同已签署要分开识别 |
| 收件信息确认邮件 | 待寄样 | LiTime Sample Shipping Confirmation — Address Verification | free sample; product value; return required; customs; duties | full name; phone number; email; shipping address; city; state; ZIP code; country | product SKU; model; voltage; quantity; color; compatible setup | address confirmed; tax ID; recipient; warehouse | 合同或合作方案确认后，核对样品及收件信息 | 高 | 已整理 | 地址齐全且产品型号确认后才能进入发货阶段 |
| 发货通知邮件 | 已发货 | Your LiTime Product Has Shipped | shipment; sample shipped; product dispatched | recipient name; phone; delivery contact | tracking number; carrier; UPS; FedEx; DHL; estimated delivery; ETA; shipment status | warehouse; shipping date; tracking link | 样品已经从仓库发出 | 高 | 已整理 | 必须识别到运单号或明确shipped/dispatched |
| 收货与测试跟进 | 已签收-测试中 | LiTime Product Delivery and Testing Follow-Up | received; arrived; delivered; thank you for the product; testing; trial; installation | technical contact; support email | product condition; installation; compatibility; test progress; issue; damaged; missing parts | delivery confirmation; testing schedule; content plan | 红人已收到样品，正在安装、测试或筹备内容 | 高 | 已整理 | 物流显示签收但红人未确认时，可标记为“疑似已签收” |
| Brief与脚本确认 | 内容策划 | LiTime Content Brief and Key Talking Points | content brief; key message; product benefits; talking points; brand guideline; required mention | content manager; editor; producer | script; storyboard; filming plan; content angle; product demo; usage scenario | do not mention; mandatory points; disclaimer; campaign hashtag | 红人准备拍摄，双方确认内容方向和核心卖点 | 高 | 已整理 | 高客单产品建议在正式拍摄前完成此阶段 |
| 初稿审核邮件 | 内容审核 | LiTime Content Review and Feedback | draft; rough cut; preview; first version; review link; feedback; revision; edit | editor; producer; content contact | video file; Google Drive; Dropbox; unlisted link; caption draft; thumbnail requested changes; factual error; missing link; product claim | 红人提交脚本、视频初稿、预览链接或文案供品牌审核 |  | 高 | 已整理 | 出现修改意见时仍处于审核阶段，不能识别为已发布 |
| 发布排期确认 | 待发布 | LiTime Content Publishing Schedule Confirmation | publish; posting date; scheduled; go live; launch date; embargo; release date | creator timezone; publishing contact | final link; creator code; UTM link; pinned comment; description; hashtags | date; time zone; platform; scheduled time | 内容审核完成，双方锁定正式发布时间 | 高 | 已整理 | 必须区分“预计发布”与“已正式上线” |
| 内容已发布 | 已发布 | Thank You for Publishing — Final Link Check | live; published; posted; now live; video is up; content is live | creator contact; manager | YouTube link; Instagram post; TikTok link; pinned comment; description link; discount code | public URL; posting date; views; comments; engagement | 红人已正式发布内容，品牌方检查链接、Code和交付完整性 | 高 | 已整理 | 识别到公开链接或明确now live后进入已发布 |
| 付款结算邮件 | 结算中/已付款 | LiTime Collaboration Payment Confirmation | invoice; payment; PayPal; Wise; bank transfer; payment terms; amount due; paid; processed; payment proof | finance email; PayPal email; account holder; bank account; SWIFT; IBAN | invoice number; delivery approved; payment date; expected arrival | currency; tax form; W-8BEN; receipt; transaction ID | 交付验收完成后处理费用支付 | 高 | 已整理 | “Invoice received”是待付款；“payment sent/processed”才是已付款 |
